record.original_question: Let X be a proper geodesic Gromov hyperbolic space, let Gamma be a discrete cocompact subgroup of Isom(X), and let N be an infinite normal subgroup of Gamma. In this setting one knows that the exponential growth rate delta(N) satisfies delta(N) > (1/2) delta(Gamma). When is this lower bound sharp, and in particular do there exist normal subgroups N_i normal in Gamma such that delta(N_i) / delta(Gamma) tends to 1/2?

evidence.quote: In the more general case it is known [29, 55, 45, 4] that delta(N) > 1/2 delta(Gamma).
Question 4.3. When is this bound sharp? Do there exist N_i normal in Gamma with delta(N_i) / delta(Gamma) -> 1/2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a proper geodesic Gromov hyperbolic metric space, and let $\Gamma$ be a discrete subgroup of $\mathrm{Isom}(X)$ that acts cocompactly on $X$. For a subgroup $H \le \Gamma$, define the exponential growth rate (critical exponent) by
$$\delta(H) \;=\; \limsup_{R\to\infty} \frac{1}{R}\,\log\#\{g \in H : d(o, g\cdot o) \le R\},$$
where $o \in X$ is a fixed basepoint (the value is independent of $o$).

It is known that for every infinite normal subgroup $N \trianglelefteq \Gamma$ one has the strict inequality
$$\delta(N) \;>\; \tfrac{1}{2}\,\delta(\Gamma).$$

Determine the conditions under which this bound is sharp. In particular, decide whether there exists a sequence of infinite normal subgroups $N_i \trianglelefteq \Gamma$ such that
$$\frac{\delta(N_i)}{\delta(\Gamma)} \;\longrightarrow\; \tfrac{1}{2}\qquad\text{as } i\to\infty,$$
and characterize the pairs $(\Gamma, X)$ for which such an approximating sequence exists.
artifact.category_tag: Cogrowth of normal subgroups in hyperbolic groups
artifact.status_search_result: The strict inequality δ(N) > (1/2)δ(Γ) for infinite normal subgroups in cocompact actions on hyperbolic spaces is established (Jaerisch–Matsuzaki–Yabuki; Arzhantseva–Cashen–Tao; Coulon and others). However, the sharpness question—whether the ratio δ(N_i)/δ(Γ) can be pushed arbitrarily close to 1/2 along a sequence of normal subgroups, and a characterization of when this occurs—does not appear to have been resolved in the literature surveyed; it is stated as an open question in current work on growth gaps and cogrowth.

status_evidence.title: Cogrowth for group actions with strongly contracting elements
status_evidence.snippet: If G has purely exponential growth and N is infinite normal, δ_N/δ_G > 1/2.
status_evidence.claim: The strict lower bound 1/2 is established; sharpness via approaching sequences is not asserted.

status_evidence.title: Growth gap in hyperbolic groups and amenability
status_evidence.snippet: Studies growth gap and amenability in hyperbolic groups.
status_evidence.claim: Provides growth-gap context but does not resolve whether δ(N_i)/δ(Γ) → 1/2 is achievable.

status_evidence.title: Relative Growth in Hyperbolic Groups
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates relative growth of subgroups in hyperbolic groups.
status_evidence.claim: Relevant background; the sharpness question for normal subgroups remains discussed as open.
